result.title: CEVA: Complementary Evidence Verification via Frame-Level Reorganization for Short-Video Fake News Detection
result.summary: Short-video platforms are now a common way for the public to follow unfolding events. Their rapid, visually persuasive format also makes fake news easier to spread. Unlike text-image posts, short-video news interleaves multiple modalities and changing scenes, making it difficult to identify which frames verify a claim. Existing detectors either pool sampled frames homogeneously or select them by text-frame similarity. Both overlook that aligned frames may repeat a misleading claim, whereas less dominant context may challenge it. We present CEVA (Complementary Evidence Verification Approach), to our knowledge the first short-video fake news detection framework to explicitly organize frames by their evidential roles before multimodal fusion. Its Dual-Branch Complementary Reorganization (DBCR) module separates explicit-alignment frames from candidate complementary-context frames, and cross-modal fusion with bidirectional contrastive regularization operates on the reorganized evidence. On FakeSV and FakeTT, CEVA achieves the best overall results among the compared methods. Under fixed frame budgets and backbones, DBCR outperforms uniform, random, and similarity-based selection and improves two structurally different detectors. Together, these results establish pre-fusion evidence organization as an effective and transferable component of short-video fake news detection.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CEVA 短视频假新闻检测框架，在融合前用双分支模块把帧分为「显式对齐」与「互补上下文」两类证据并重组，再以双向对比正则做跨模态融合；在 FakeSV、FakeTT 上取得较好结果，并显示该重组在固定帧预算下优于均匀、随机和相似度选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心观察——按文本-帧相似度选帧会只取重复误导性主张的帧、漏掉挑战性上下文——可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与「LOOK」策略，以及相似度选择偏差是否有对应诊断价值；但方法本身不是 latent 状态推理，迁移需判断。
